answer: Before an identity earns anything it escrows a bond and the node stores the machine fingerprint that signed the join, so cloning the ticket means buying that stake again for every replica. A second panel rechecks any submission that scored high the first time, using auditors from a rotating pool rather than the same names. That keeps the honest path boring: a farmer pays full timber and power per copy, while an honest operator needs one lantern and a slow walk to the summit, not a fleet.
